file_ready:

err_revoked: 🚫 This link is no longer active.
err_unsupported: ⚠️ This file type is not supported.
err_delivery: ⚠️ Delivery failed. Please try again shortly.
err_flow_expired: ⌛ This request expired. Open the file link again to restart.
err_generic: ⚠️ Something went wrong. Please try again.
err_db: ⚠️ Service temporarily unavailable. Please try again soon.
verify_not_member: ❌ Not verified yet. Please join the channel, then press Verify Access again.
verify_request_missing: ⏳ Your join request hasn't been received yet. Send it with the button, then verify again.
verify_api_error: ⚠️ Couldn't check right now. Please try again in a moment.
a_stats: 📊 Statistics 📅 Today 👥 New bot users: {t_users} 📥 Files requested: {t_opens} ✅ Files delivered: {t_delivered} 📨 Join requests (all channels): {t_requests} 📈 Total 👥 Bot users: {users} · 📂 Files: {files} ✅ Delivered: {deliveries_ok} · ❌ Failed: {deliveries_failed} Per-channel joins and requests: Channels → Channel Statistics.
a_files_menu: 📂 Files Send any file straight to this chat, or post it in your DB channel, and a permanent link is created automatically.
a_search_prompt: 🔍 Send part of a file name to search.
a_revoke_confirm: 🚫 Revoke this link? Other links to the same file keep working.
a_archived: 🗄 File archived. Its links stop working until the file is re-added.
a_delete_confirm: 🗑 Delete this file and all of its links permanently?
a_protection: 🔒 Content protection Default: {state} Protected files cannot be forwarded or saved in supported Telegram clients. It cannot stop screenshots or every form of copying. Each file can override the default.
a_channel_add: ➕ Add channel Send a public @username, a channel ID (-100…), or forward any message from the channel. The bot must be an admin there (private channels also need the “Invite users” right).
a_channel_bad_ref: ⚠️ Couldn't read that. Send @username, -100… ID or a forwarded channel message.
a_channel_inaccessible: ⚠️ Channel not found or the bot has no access. Add the bot as admin and retry.
a_channel_wrong_type: ⚠️ Only channels and supergroups can be used.
a_channel_not_admin: ⚠️ The bot is not an admin there. Promote it and retry.
a_channel_added_public: ✅ {title} added (public — membership is checked on Verify).
a_channel_need_invite: 🔗 {title} is private and the bot couldn't create a join-request link. Send an invite link (https://t.me/+…) created with Request admin approval enabled. The bot never approves or declines requests.
a_channel_added_private: ✅ {title} added (private — a join request event completes the step; requests are never auto-approved).
a_channel_bad_invite: ⚠️ That is not a valid invite link (https://t.me/+… or https://t.me/joinchat/…).
a_channel_need_invite_short: Bot can't create a join-request link there. Check the “Invite users” right.
a_channel_no_username: This channel has no public username, so it can't switch to public mode.
a_channel_remove_confirm: 🗑 Remove this channel from the pool? Statistics are kept; running flows skip it.
a_balancing: ⚖️ Balancing Current: {mode} Least presented = lowest presentation count first, random tie-break.
a_reset_confirm: ♻️ Reset all presentation counters to 0? Joins and requests are not touched.
a_bc_prompt: 📣 Broadcast Send the message to broadcast (text or media).
a_bc_confirm:
📣 Preview sent above.

Audience: all reachable users (≈ {audience}).

Send it now?
a_set_image: 🖼️ Send the new welcome media: a photo, video or GIF (video/GIF up to 50 MB; short loops of 3-8 s work best).
a_set_text: ✏️ Send the new welcome text (max 900 chars). Plain text; the first line becomes the bold title; use {first_name} for the user's name. One text applies to all languages.
a_set_buttons: 🔘 Send extra welcome buttons, one per line: Label | https://example.com (max 6)
a_set_channels: 📢 Send the official channel list, one per line: Title | https://t.me/name (max 20)
a_set_about: ℹ️ Send the new About text (max 900 chars, plain text).
a_clear_confirm: 🧽 Clear/reset this setting to its default?
a_need_photo: ⚠️ Send a photo, video or GIF.
a_bad_url: ⚠️ Invalid URL. Use http(s)://… with a real domain.
a_bad_pairs: ⚠️ Invalid format. Use Label | URL per line (label ≤ 40 chars, valid URLs, within the limit).
a_preview_failed: ⚠️ Preview failed to render. Nothing was saved.
a_languages: 🌐 Language options Toggle which languages users can pick, and set the default. Disabling a language never deletes user records; those users fall back to the default.
a_lang_keep: Keep at least one language enabled, and don't disable the default.
a_dbch_menu: 🗄 DB Channel Current: {current} Reply with link in channel: {reply} Add the bot as admin of a private channel and set it here. Files posted there are saved automatically, and files you send to the bot are copied there as a durable backup. Links are sent to you in this chat.
a_dbch_set:
🗄 Send the DB channel @username, -100… ID, or forward a message from it.

The bot must be an admin there (enable “Post messages” so it can reply with links).
a_dbch_not_channel: ⚠️ Only a channel can be used as the DB channel.
a_saved_preview: ✅ Saved and applied. A preview is shown above (it disappears in a few minutes); /start shows the live card.
file_deleting: ⏳ Auto-delete: this file will be removed in {minutes} min. Forward or save it now. Open the link again to get it back.
a_filead: 🗑 File auto-delete Current: {cur} Auto removes each delivered media after its own length + 1 minute (a 2-min video stays 3 min); files without a length (documents, photos) use 5 min. Users can reopen the link to get the file again.
a_dur_prompt: ⏱ Send the media length: seconds (150), 2:30 or 1:02:30. Auto-delete will use length + 1 minute. Needed only for files sent as documents (Telegram gives them no length); videos learn it automatically.
a_dur_bad: ⚠️ Use seconds (150), mm:ss (2:30) or h:mm:ss (1:02:30), up to 24 h.
a_db_none: 🗄 DB channel: not set — the file is kept only by Telegram's file_id (set one in Files → DB Channel)
a_db_fail_rights: 🗄 DB channel: ⚠️ NOT copied — give the bot “Post messages” in that channel
a_db_fail_chat: 🗄 DB channel: ⚠️ NOT copied — bot isn't in that channel (or it was deleted). Set it again.
a_db_fail: 🗄 DB channel: ⚠️ NOT copied — Telegram refused. Check the bot is admin there.
a_dbch_no_post: ⚠️ The bot has no “Post messages” right here, so files you send to the bot cannot be copied. Enable it.
a_lang_reset: Your language was reset. Send /start (or open a file link) to see the language screen again.
a_cs_other: ↪️ {n} requests came through other / old invite links (not counted above)
a_cs_errors: ⚠️ {n} membership lookups failed — make sure the bot is an admin there
a_cs_reset_confirm: 🧹 Reset all channel statistics (joins, leaves, requests, today and total) to 0? Channel rotation is not affected.
